highlightsParams.query: The Tailwind CSS release being described is version 4.0.

passages:
[Tailwind CSS v4.0]

Tailwind CSS v4.0 is an all-new version of the framework optimized for performance and flexibility, with a reimagined configuration and customization experience, and taking full advantage of the latest advancements the web platform has to offer.

…

[Tailwind CSS v4.0 > New high-performance engine]

| | v3.4 | v4.0 | Improvement |
| - | - | - | - |
| Full build | 378ms | 100ms | 3.78x |
| Incremental rebuild with new CSS | 44ms | 5ms | 8.8x |
| Incremental rebuild with no new CSS | 35ms | 192µs | 182x |
